Issue: Company dashboard applicant modal displayed raw JSON payload instead of formatted profile data.
Fix: Removed raw JSON auto-display block; modal now populates name, role, and status fields from structured API response.
Result: Applicant modal shows clean, formatted profile. No raw JSON visible to users.

Issue: Applicant name displayed as blank or `undefined` when viewing applications; profile fields not populated.
Fix: Fixed `getApplication` to fully populate `applicant` and `job` sub-documents; derived full name from `firstName`/`lastName` with email fallback.
Result: Applicant names render correctly across all dashboard views.

Issue: Flex overflow in dashboard applicant item caused layout to break on smaller viewports.
Fix: Added `overflow: hidden` and adjusted flex constraints on the applicant item container.
Result: Dashboard applicant list renders cleanly at all supported breakpoints.

Issue: Job Management table rendered incorrect number of columns; `colspan` values did not match the 5-column header.
Fix: Updated table render logic to output exactly 5 `<td>` cells per row and corrected `colspan` on empty-state messages.
Result: Table columns align with headers; no visual misalignment.

Issue: Edit job link in the Job Management table pointed to a non-existent path, causing a 404 on click.
Fix: Updated link to the correct relative path `addEdit/job-post.html`.
Result: Edit button navigates correctly to the job post edit form.

Issue: Job detail links on the company dashboard used absolute paths that broke under Railway's static routing.
Fix: Changed all job detail links to relative paths (`pages/jobs/…`) so the server static route resolves correctly.
Result: Job detail pages open without 404 errors in production.

Issue: Latest jobs section on homepage failed to load in Railway production due to a cross-origin API call causing CSP violations.
Fix: Refactored `API_BASE_URL` initialization to detect environment and use same-origin paths in production.
Result: Job listings load correctly on the live Railway deployment.

Issue: Admin company list did not render; company list page showed a blank table.
Fix: Fixed data-fetch logic and rendering pipeline for admin company list view.
Result: Admin can view, filter, and manage the full company list.

Issue: Modal "View" mode was inadvertently broken; clicking View on an applicant opened an empty modal.
Fix: Restored modal view-mode logic and re-wired open/close event handlers.
Result: Modal opens correctly in read-only view mode; data populates as expected.

Issue: Edit button in admin dashboard modal did not trigger the edit flow; button click was unresponsive.
Fix: Rewired edit button click handler and corrected selector targeting the modal's edit trigger.
Result: Edit button opens the edit form with pre-populated fields.

Issue: `src/app.js` became corrupted with duplicate and dead code blocks, causing the backend server to fail to start.
Fix: Repaired `app.js` by removing all duplicate middleware registrations and dead route blocks.
Result: Backend server starts cleanly; no duplicate route warnings.

Issue: Duplicate index on `UserProfile` model caused MongoDB to throw an error on startup when `version 1.1.0` changes were applied.
Fix: Removed duplicate unique index definition from the `UserProfile` schema.
Result: MongoDB connects without index errors; profile creation and lookup work correctly.

Issue: User profile data was not populating on profile dashboard after login; fields appeared empty.
Fix: Fixed population logic for `UserProfile` to correctly resolve the linked `User` document.
Result: Profile dashboard displays all user fields (name, skills, experience, education) after login.

Issue: Google OAuth login for admin accounts did not correctly associate the OAuth profile with the admin `UserProfile`.
Fix: Corrected the Google auth callback to look up existing accounts by email before creating a new profile; linked existing admin record.
Result: Admin Google OAuth login now resolves to the correct profile and role.

Issue: Job details page displayed incorrect or missing job title in the `<h1>` heading; ID reference was wrong.
Fix: Corrected element ID reference for job title; updated header to use the populated title field.
Result: Job title renders correctly on all job detail pages.

Issue: Job detail URL construction failed in GitHub Pages subpath deployments, producing broken links.
Fix: Updated URL builder to detect base path and prepend the correct subpath prefix.
Result: Job detail links work on both GitHub Pages and Railway deployments.

Issue: Login redirect sent users to the wrong dashboard after authentication (profile dashboard instead of company dashboard for employers).
Fix: Updated login redirect logic to check user role and route to the appropriate dashboard dynamically.
Result: Jobseekers land on `profileDashboard.html`; employers on `companyDashboard.html` after login.

Issue: S3 resume upload GitHub Actions workflow had an indentation error in the Terraform YAML, causing CI to fail.
Fix: Fixed YAML indentation in the S3 workflow file.
Result: CI workflow passes; Terraform plan and apply steps execute correctly.

Issue: Job post form "Close" button had no handler; clicking it did nothing.
Fix: Added `history.back()` fallback and a redirect to the job list as a backup close action.
Result: Close button exits the form and returns users to the previous page or job list.

Issue: Accessibility issues on job-post and about pages: missing `<label>` associations, unlabelled landmarks, and low-contrast text.
Fix: Added explicit `for`/`id` label pairs, `aria-hidden` on decorative elements, and adjusted foreground colours to meet WCAG AA contrast ratios.
Result: Pages pass automated accessibility checks; contrast ratios meet WCAG AA minimum (4.5:1).

Issue: API base URL was hardcoded to `localhost:8080` in Postman collections and the API reference, breaking testing against the actual `localhost:3000` backend.
Fix: Updated all URL references in docs and Postman collections to `localhost:3000`.
Result: Postman requests and API reference docs point to the correct local development port.

Issue: Job post form `industry` and `japaneseLevel` select values did not match backend enum values, causing validation errors on submission.
Fix: Aligned frontend `<select>` option values with backend enum definitions for both fields.
Result: Job post form submits without validation errors; jobs are created successfully.

Issue: `leftover allApps` variable counts and duplicate `const` declarations in `companyDashboard.js` caused a runtime `SyntaxError`.
Fix: Removed stale variable declarations and deduplicated conflicting `const` blocks.
Result: Company dashboard loads without JavaScript runtime errors in the browser console.

Issue: API endpoint for fetching the employer's own posted jobs used the wrong route, returning an empty list on the dashboard.
Fix: Updated the fetch call to use the correct endpoint `GET /api/v1/jobs/my` with the appropriate `Authorization` header.
Result: Employer's posted jobs load correctly on the company dashboard Job List card.

Issue: Navigation desktop links for authenticated users did not update when a JWT was present; "Login/Signup" buttons remained visible after sign-in.
Fix: Enhanced `headerAuth.js` to re-evaluate the JWT on each page load and update the desktop nav links to show "Dashboard" and "Logout" instead.
Result: Navigation reflects correct auth state on all pages after login and logout.
